slowest_experiments.experiment: V609 post-marker source delta and compatibility audit
V609 advisory execution-contract and gate-cascade audit

summary: The milestone completed 12 experiments in 24.7 minutes, including 3 compute-bound experiments. The 17.21-minute compute-bound mapping-bank task set the critical path, while the locked GPU-idle indicator remained false.
bottlenecks_identified: Three-family SOTA reformulation mapping bank consumed 17.21 minutes, but the available data does not identify which internal phase caused the delay.
V609 post-marker source delta and compatibility audit consumed 6.22 minutes. It was synthesis-only, so GPU use was not applicable and is not a GPU bottleneck.
The GPU monitor found a single Python inference process and recommended multi-question batching. This indicates unused throughput capacity even though the compute-bound path was not idle.
Timing came from disk-mtime reconstruction because the live git-log path found no commits. This limits phase-level diagnosis.
improvements_suggested: Batch 8-16 questions per forward pass in single-process inference workflows; the GPU monitor estimates a 4-8x throughput improvement.
Record phase timings and task-window GPU utilization for each compute-bound experiment so the mapping-bank critical path has a measurable cause.
Write task-owned timing receipts that do not depend on git commits, which avoids disk-mtime reconstruction.
Record model count and runner choice at launch so DualGPURunner eligibility can be audited directly.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Add configurable 8-16 question batching to the single-process inference path.
Capture per-phase duration and task-window GPU utilization for compute-bound experiments.
Emit direct timing, model-count, and runner-selection receipts for every launch.
meta_reflection: The data supports accelerator engagement, not full-task GPU efficiency, because one snapshot cannot characterize all compute-bound work. It contains no evidence of two or more models loaded in parallel, so a missed DualGPURunner dispatch cannot be claimed.
